usage: The word 粽子 (zung2 zi2) is a noun referring to a type of sticky rice dumpling.
It can be used as the subject or object in a sentence, such as 我想食粽子 (I want to eat sticky rice dumplings).
粽子 often appears in conversations about traditional festivals, especially Dragon Boat Festival.
When describing粽子, adjectives can be added before it, like 好食嘅粽子 (delicious sticky rice dumplings).
You can also use 粽子 in questions to ask about preferences or availability, e.g. 你鍾意食粽子嗎？ (Do you like eating sticky rice dumplings?).
